facts.text: Peru’s landscapes include Pacific coastal desert, the Andes, and Amazon rainforest.
Machu Picchu preserves an Inca citadel.

culture.text: Ancient Andean artistic traditions include stone carving, ceramics, and metalwork.

food.name: Ceviche
food.text: Fish or seafood is marinated in citrus juice; preparations vary across the country.
